messages:
sara (Docs): Heads-up — we're scheduling a v1 API sunset for next month. Need a docs checklist: migration guide updates, SDK snippets, model-swap examples, redirect rules, and small 'safeguard' snippets teams can drop in to avoid outages. Who can take point on each?

kevin (SDK): I can own SDK snippets. Planning a compat wrapper + tiny examples for v1->v2. Will open a draft PR by EOD and add tests. cc @matt (Eng)

matt (Eng): Thanks. For model swaps, please include a runtime fallback example to an older compatible variant. Also call out rate-limiter/backoff headers. Quick illustrative snippet:
```
# compatibility wrapper (py)
def generate(req):
    try:
        return v2.client.generate(req)
    except IncompatibleModelError:
        return v1.client.generate(req)
```

yara (DevRel): Can we also publish a minimal "safe start" snippet that teams can opt into to auto-fallback if they detect quality/regression? I'll add it into the quickstart repo and make a small sample app.

ellen (Product): Important: comms timeline — marketing will announce a week before sunset. Docs must contain: explicit migration path, a short "what changed and why" paragraph, and a clear note on embeddings/embedding-id changes.

sam (Support): Please add a one-click rollback snippet and a short Dedicated-specific checklist (capacity pinning, model pin overrides). These reduce noisy support tickets during rollback windows.

kevin (SDK): Draft PR up: https://github.com/redwoodinc/docs/pull/2345 — added compat wrapper, basic tests, and a small migration checklist. Needs docs + eng review.

sara (Docs): I'll review the PR. One guideline: keep inline snippets <= 7 lines so they remain copy-paste friendly. Longer examples should be behind a "See full example" link or in the sample-app repo.

matt (Eng): Added unit tests to the SDK PR and noted streaming framing changes in v2 — we should add an item in the streaming guide about the new chunk framing and consumer changes.

docs-bot: Deploy preview created: https://deploy.preview.redwood.ai/sha/abcdef — please smoke-test the migration page and snippets on the preview.

yara (DevRel): :thumbsup: I'll run through and add the example app PR tomorrow morning, and link it from the migration guide. tagging @kevin for API signature alignment.

sara (Docs): Great work — I'll open an umbrella PR that wires redirects, adds a troubleshooting section, and includes the safeguard snippets. Ping here when your PRs are ready for final merge. :sparkles:
